comment: Authored fixture, NOT a live capture: the run_command step is the documentation's own real tool-step example (conversation edb1c8c1, https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/headless/, accessed 2026-10-02). The second tool step applies the documentation's tool_info error shape (error object with type and message, emitted when a tool fails — the in-stream form of a soft-denied/failed tool in headless mode) and the turn still ends in a SUCCESS result, which is exactly the case the plan boundary covers: SUCCESS must not hide the tool failure.

error.message: write_to_file requires approval that cannot be obtained in headless mode; add a permissions.allow rule or pass --dangerously-skip-permissions

result.response: The command ran; the file write was denied, so the note was not saved.
